card.name: Paoa
card.tagline: Seated Tahitian circle dance with a soloist couple.
card.profile: The paoa is a dance in which performers kneel or sit in a circle, sing and tap their thighs to a repetitive scanning refrain (patautau), while a selected boy and girl dance inside the circle. It is traditionally linked to tapa (barkcloth) making - women beat bark in rhythm and sang to break the monotony. Themes are usually hunting or fishing; being chosen for the central solo is an honor signifying a teacher's recognition (English Wikipedia; The Tahiti Traveler).
card.insight: The seated, thigh-slapping format derives from the communal rhythm of beating bark to make tapa cloth (The Tahiti Traveler).
